decision_statement: Whether Acme should launch a paid pilot of its scheduling tool with three clinics this quarter.
goal: Learn whether clinics will pay for automated scheduling before investing in a full launch.
options: Delay until the integration is finished
constraints: No integration with clinic records yet

assumptions.statement: Clinics feel the scheduling pain strongly enough to pay.
assumptions.label: hypothesis

unknowns: Willingness to pay at the proposed price
research_questions: What do comparable tools charge small clinics?
